messages:
devon: FYI opened GH PR to consolidate function/tool-calling examples and fix broken anchors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892
kai: Link thanks. What are the concrete asks?
devon: 1) pick canonical shape (I propose `call_frame` wrapper), 2) add tiny Py/Node parse-fallback snippets, 3) sweep anchors that changed after reorg (build failing).
anya: I like `call_frame` too. Keeps upgrade-safe. Can we show both `call_frame` and legacy flat example and include a short parse helper?
michael: Yes. Also call out nullable arrays and null params as common parsing traps. I'll draft a minimal JSON Schema for `call_frame` and a one-line note about nullable arrays.
kai: I'll add two snippets under docs/snippets/call_frame: python.md and node.md. Each will show generate + parseCallframeFallback() usage. Keep them tiny.
devon: For anchors: I found a few links that point to /docs/structured-output#json-shape and now fail. We'll map old ids to kebab-case stable ids and add a small link-check rule that fails on headers with backticks/parens.
anya: I'll update the main docs page to recommend `call_frame` and include migration blurb: "Use parseCallframeFallback() to accept both shapes during rollout."
michael: Draft schema: 
```
{ "type":"object","properties":{"call_frame":{"type":"object","properties":{"tool":{"type":"string"},"params":{"type":["object","null"]}},"required":["tool"]}},"required":["call_frame"] }
```
kai: Pushing snippets shortly. docs-bot: Staging deploy successful; link-check queued.
devon: Once snippets and anchor PRs are up, I'll run link-check and merge if green. Thanks team!
